verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a fleet-management SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers installing the on-device Formant agent (e.g. via Docker), which uploads data to Formant's cloud. Nothing shows the core platform (web app, APIs, analytics) can be self-hosted, and an edge agent is an adjacent component rather than the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
